name: FryGovernance

methods.name: create
methods.desc: Initialize the contract with admin and FRY ASA ID.

methods.name: admin_propose_update
methods.desc: Propose a contract update. Must wait 48 hours before executing.

methods.name: opt_in_fry
methods.desc: Opt contract into FRY ASA (admin only).

methods.name: admin_set_min_balance
methods.desc: Set minimum FRY balance for temp check voting (admin only).

methods.name: admin_set_price
methods.desc: Update price value and USD flag (admin only).

methods.name: create_vote
methods.desc:
Create a new vote (admin only).
Atomic group: [Payment, AppCall]

methods.name: cast_vote
methods.desc:
Cast a vote with FRY token staking.
Atomic group: [Payment, AssetTransfer, AppCall]

methods.name: cast_temp_vote
methods.desc:
Cast a temperature check vote (no token movement).
One person = one vote. Requires minimum FRY balance.
Atomic group: [Payment, AppCall]
NOTE: The app call must include: - Foreign assets: [fry_asa_id]

methods.name: request_temp_check
methods.desc:
Create a temperature check vote (any eligible user).
Requirements: - Caller must have minimum FRY balance (same as voting) - Payment covers vote box MBR - End date must be in future and within 7-day max duration
Atomic group: [Payment, AppCall] Foreign assets: [fry_asa_id]

methods.name: withdraw
methods.desc:
Withdraw staked FRY tokens after lock period expires.
Self-service - caller must be the original voter. Deletes stake box and refunds MBR.

methods.name: admin_emergency_refund
methods.desc:
Emergency refund of staked tokens and MBR (admin only).
Use case: Bug recovery, disputes. Deletes stake box.

methods.name: get_stake
methods.desc: Get stake record for a voter on a specific vote.

desc:
FryGovernance: On-chain voting system for Fry Networks

    Features:
    - FIP/cFIP voting with token staking and 6-month lock
    - Temperature checks using FryStaking V2 balances
    - Self-service withdrawal (no hot wallet)
    - Admin-upgradeable for bug fixes
